name: Norgorberite Poisoner AP OLD
source: Pathfinder #160: Assault on Hunting Lodge Seven

items.name: Dagger
items.description: This small, bladed weapon is held in one hand and used to stab a creature in close combat. It can also be thrown.

items.name: +1 Striking Shortsword
items.description: These blades come in a variety of shapes and styles, but they are typically 2 feet long.

items.name: Leather Armor
items.description: A mix of flexible and molded boiled leather, a suit of this type of armor provides some protection with maximum flexibility.

items.name: Thieves' Tools (Infiltrator)
items.description:
You need thieves' tools to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Pick a Lock]{Pick Locks} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Disable a Device]{Disable Devices} (of some types) using the Thievery skill. Infiltrator thieves' tools add a +1 item bonus to checks to Pick Locks and Disable Devices.

If your thieves' tools are broken, you can repair them by replacing the lock picks with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Thieves' Toolkit (Infiltrator Picks)]{Replacement Picks} appropriate to your tools; this doesn't require using the Repair action. If you wear your thieves' tools, you can draw and replace them as part of the action that uses them.

defensiveAbilities.name: Deny Advantage
defensiveAbilities.description: The poisoner isn't off-guard to creatures of 11th level or lower that are hidden, undetected, flanking, or using surprise attack.

defensiveAbilities.name: Nimble Dodge
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The poisoner is targeted with a melee or ranged attack by an attacker it can see

Effect The poisoner gains a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack.

offensiveAbilities.name: Impromptu Toxin
offensiveAbilities.description:
Cost 1 batch of infused reagents

Effect The poisoner dribbles a few experimental chemicals over a melee weapon. Until the start of their next turn, Strikes with the weapon deal an additional 2d8 Poison Damage damage, and targets hit by Strikes with the weapon must succeed at a DC 27 Fortitude Saving Throw save or become Enfeebled 1 or Clumsy 1 (the poisoner's choice) for 1d4 rounds.

offensiveAbilities.name: Sneak Attack
offensiveAbilities.description: The poisoner deals an additional 3d6 precision damage to Off-Guard creatures.

offensiveAbilities.name: Unbalancing Blow
offensiveAbilities.description: Creatures the poisoner hits with a critical hit are Off-Guard against their attacks until the end of their next turn.
